subject: DI03000101

body.en:
Understand the idea

A single-line diagram represents a three-phase network by one path and standard equipment functions,not one physical wire.

Explanation and application

  • Generation supplies electrical energy;generator transformers step up voltage for transmission.At fixed power,higher voltage reduces current and line I²R loss.
  • Grid substations switch,protect and transform voltage;subtransmission feeds distribution substations.Primary distribution supplies local transformers;secondary distribution and service mains reach consumers.
  • Include circuit breakers,isolators used only under their permitted duties,metering,protection and earthing.The drawing must identify nominal voltage and source/load boundaries.
Does a covered conductor mean touch-safe?

No;it is not automatically a fully insulated cable.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Single-line diagram ત્રણ-phase networkને એક path/equipment functionsથી બતાવે છે;એક physical wire નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Generation વિદ્યુત ઊર્જા આપે છે.Transformer voltage વધારે છે.Same powerમાં V વધતાં I/line I²R loss ઘટે છે.
  • Grid substation switching,protection/V transformation કરે છે.Subtransmission પછી primary distribution/local transformer અને secondary/service mainsથી consumer સુધી supply પહોંચે છે.
  • Breaker,permitted-duty isolator,metering,protection/earthing બતાવો.Nominal V/source-load boundaries લખો.
Covered એટલે Touch-safe?

નહિ.તે આપોઆપ fully insulated cable નથી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Classify first by AC/DC,overhead/underground,length/electrical model and nominal voltage.

Explanation and application

  • Textbook overhead-line models often use short below about80km,medium about80–250km,long above about250km.These are approximate teaching boundaries,not universal design rules or legal voltage classes.
  • Common Indian ACnetwork examples include11,22,33,66,110,132,220,400and765kV,depending on state/application;not every system uses every level.Low-voltage230/400Vnominal and240/415Vutility/textbook labels require the actual supply convention.
  • For balanced three-phase calculation use phase V=VLL/√3;do not apply that AC√3conversion to a DCpole rating,where ±Vnormally states each pole-to-earth magnitude.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

પહેલાં AC/DC,overhead-underground,length/model અને nominal Vથી વર્ગીકરણ કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Textbookમાં short લગભગ80km નીચે,medium લગભગ80–250km/long લગભગ250km ઉપર છે.આ teaching boundaries છે;universal design/legal classes નથી.
  • Indian AC examplesમાં11,22,33,66,110,132,220,400/765kV આવે છે.State/use પ્રમાણે બધાં levels જરૂરી નથી.LV230/400V nominal કે240/415V labels માટે actual utility convention ચકાસો.
  • Balanced three-phaseમાં Vphase=VLL/√3 લો.DC ±V સામાન્ય રીતે pole-earth magnitude છે;તેમાં AC√3 conversion નકરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Compare life-cycle performance and site constraints rather than choosing by appearance alone.

Explanation and application

  • Overhead has accessible conductors,easier fault localisation and usually lower installation cost,but is exposed to weather,vegetation,lightning and corridor/visual constraints.
  • Underground reduces visual/weather exposure and suits congested corridors,but excavation,joints,thermal soil conditions,capacitance and repair time may dominate cost and operation.
  • Both require rated protection,clearances,earthing and maintenance.Underground cable is neither lossless nor maintenance-free;overhead bare conductors are not safe to touch.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

ફક્ત દેખાવથી નહિ,life-cycle performance/site constraintsથી તુલના કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Overheadમાં conductor accessible,fault શોધવું સરળ/installation સામાન્ય રીતે સસ્તું છે;પણ weather,vegetation,lightning/corridorની અસર વધુ છે.
  • Underground congested corridorમાં યોગ્ય/દેખાવ-weather અસર ઓછી છે;પણ excavation,joints,soil thermal behaviour,C/repair time મહત્વનાં છે.
  • બંનેમાં protection,clearance,earthing/maintenance જરૂરી છે.Cable lossless-maintenance-free નથી;bare overhead touch-safe નથી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

A conductor must carry current economically while surviving mechanical and environmental loading.

Explanation and application

  • Solid wire is simple but less flexible at large size;hollow conductor places material outward and can improve effective diameter/ACuse,but needs suitable fittings and mechanical design.
  • AACuses aluminium strands:good conductivity/low mass but lower strength than reinforced choices.AAACuses aluminium alloy strands for improved strength/corrosion performance with conductivity trade-offs.
  • ACSRuses aluminium layers around steel reinforcement;steel mainly provides tensile strength.High-performance/HTLSfamilies use heat-resistant aluminium and/or low-expansion strength cores to increase useful rating within design limits.
  • Desirable properties:conductivity,strength-to-mass ratio,low cost,corrosion resistance,stable joints and thermal/creep performance.Conductor selection cannot use conductivity alone.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Conductor economical I વહન કરે અને mechanical/environmental loads સહે તે જરૂરી છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Solid સરળ પણ મોટા sizeમાં ઓછો flexible છે.Hollowમાં material બહાર તરફ હોવાથી effective diameter/AC use સુધરી શકે;યોગ્ય fittings/design જોઈએ.
  • AACમાં aluminium strandsથી conductivity/low mass મળે,પણ reinforced કરતાં strength ઓછી હોય.AAAC alloyથી strength/corrosion performance સુધારે;conductivity trade-off રહે.
  • ACSRમાં aluminium layers અને steel core છે.Core મુખ્ય tensile strength આપે.HTLSમાં heat-resistant aluminium/low-expansion coreથી design limitsમાં rating વધારી શકાય.
  • Conductivity,strength/mass,કિંમત,corrosion resistance,stable joints/thermal-creep behaviour જોઈએ.ફક્ત conductivityથી પસંદગી નકરો.

h.en: Photonic coating,covered conductor and dynamic line rating

body.en:
Understand the idea

These are different technologies:surface heat transfer,electrical covering and condition-dependent ampacity.

Explanation and application

  • Photonic/radiative coatings engineer spectral emissivity/solar behaviour to improve net heat rejection under specified conditions;performance must come from verified product/weather data,not a guaranteed universal temperature reduction.
  • A covered conductor reduces some incidental-contact faults but is not automatically a fully insulated,touch-safe cable.Approach and live-work restrictions remain.
  • DLRuses weather/conductor temperature,sag or other validated monitoring with a thermal model.Static rating assumes set conditions;DLRmay rise or fall and is constrained by the weakest equipment,clearance and uncertainty.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

આ અલગ technologies છે:surface heat transfer,electrical covering અને conditions પ્રમાણે ampacity.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Photonic/radiative coating spectral emissivity/solar behaviour બદલી specified conditionsમાં heat rejection સુધારે.Product/weather data ચકાસો;universal T reduction નધારો.
  • Covered conductor કેટલાક incidental-contact faults ઘટાડે છે;તે આપોઆપ fully insulated/touch-safe cable નથી.Approach/live-work restrictions રહે છે.
  • DLRમાં weather,T,sag/validated monitoring તથા thermal model આવે.Static rating fixed conditions ધારે.DLR વધી-ઘટી શકે;weakest equipment,clearance/uncertainty limits રહે છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

ACcurrent density is not generally uniform across a practical conductor.

Explanation and application

  • Skin effect crowds current toward the surface because alternating internal flux opposes inner current paths;ACresistance rises relative to the same-temperature DCvalue.It grows with frequency,size and magnetic permeability.
  • Proximity effect redistributes current due to nearby conductors fields;its magnitude depends on spacing,geometry and relative current phase.It is not the same mechanism as self-field skin effect.
  • Use suitable strand/segment geometry,spacing and conductor construction;ordinary stranding alone does not guarantee elimination of skin effect.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

ACમાં conductor cross-section પર current density હંમેશાં uniform નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Internal alternating fluxથી inner paths oppose થતાં current બહાર તરફ crowd થાય;AC R એ same-T DC R કરતાં વધે.Frequency,size/permeabilityથી અસર વધે.
  • નજીકના conductorsના fieldsથી current redistribute થાય છે.Spacing,geometry/relative phase મહત્વનાં છે.આ self-field skin effectથી અલગ છે.
  • યોગ્ય strand-segment geometry,spacing/construction લો.સામાન્ય strandingથી skin effect પૂરેપૂરો દૂર થાય એવું નથી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Two or more spaced subconductors form one phase and are kept apart by designed spacers.

Explanation and application

  • The greater effective radius reduces surface gradient and corona tendency,usually lowers phase inductive reactance and raises capacitance;power-transfer capability can improve.
  • Spacers/spacer dampers,fittings and vibration control must withstand wind,ice and short-circuit forces.Subconductor spacing is not phase-to-phase clearance.
  • Costs,maintenance,subspan oscillation and fitting design are trade-offs;bundling does not make an overloaded line automatically safe.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

એક phaseમાં બે કે વધુ spaced subconductors હોય;designed spacers spacing જાળવે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Effective radius વધવાથી surface gradient/corona tendency અને inductive reactance ઘટે;C સામાન્ય રીતે વધે.Power-transfer capability સુધરી શકે.
  • Spacers,dampers/fittingsએ wind,ice/SC forces સહેવા જોઈએ.Subconductor spacingને phase clearance નસમજો.
  • Cost,maintenance,oscillation/fittings trade-offs છે.Bundlingથી overloaded line આપોઆપ safe નથી થતી.

title.gu: 1.7 Steel Poles,RCC Poles તથા Lattice Towers

h.gu: Steel Poles,RCC Poles તથા Lattice Towers

body.en:
Understand the idea

Supports hold conductor geometry and transfer mechanical loads safely to foundations.

Explanation and application

  • Steel poles use tubular/fabricated steel with crossarms,base/foundation and corrosion protection;they suit compact routes but need corrosion and structural inspection.
  • RCCpoles use reinforced concrete with embedded reinforcement and designed lifting/attachment points;they resist many weather effects but are heavy and can crack if mishandled or overloaded.
  • Lattice towers use bolted steel members,bracing,crossarms,earthwire peaks and leg foundations;their triangulated structure carries long-span/EHVloads but needs land,erection and joint upkeep.
  • Choose strength,height,clearance,wind/ice loading,corrosion resistance,transport,foundation and cost;never infer climbing or handling permission from a classroom sketch.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Supports geometry જાળવી loads foundationમાં પહોંચાડે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Steel poleમાં tubular/fabricated steel,crossarm,foundation/corrosion protection હોય.Compact routeમાં યોગ્ય;corrosion/strength inspection જોઈએ.
  • RCCમાં reinforced concrete/design attachment-lifting points હોય.Weather resistance સારી પણ weight વધુ અને mishandling-overloadથી cracks થઈ શકે.
  • Latticeમાં bolted members,bracing,crossarm,earthwire peak/leg foundations હોય.Triangulationથી EHV/long-span loads સહે;જમીન,erection/joint upkeep જોઈએ.
  • Strength,height,clearance,wind-ice,corrosion,transport/foundation/costથી પસંદ કરો.Sketchને climbing/handling permission નસમજો.

body.en:
Definition

A rigid insulator supports a conductor above a crossarm.

Classification / representative type

  • Pin,suspension,strain,shackle and stay are classified by duty;this card explains Pin.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Porcelain/composite body and sheds provide dielectric strength and creepage distance.
  2. A designed pin/fixing assembly anchors the body;the top groove and approved tie hold the conductor.
  3. Crossarm hardware carries mechanical force while shed shape limits a continuous wet leakage path.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. The live conductor loads the dielectric body,which maintains separation from earthed support.
  2. Bulk dielectric withstands normal/surge stress;surface creepage withstands contaminated/wet conditions within rating.
  3. Specified voltage/mechanical limits govern use;damaged or contaminated units can flash over or puncture.

Limitations and safety

Use the specified dielectric,voltage and mechanical rating;handling/maintenance only by authorised personnel.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Rigid insulator crossarm ઉપર conductor support કરે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Duty પ્રમાણે pin,suspension,strain,shackle/stay છે.આ card Pin સમજાવે છે.

Construction — ભાગ તથા કામ

  1. Porcelain-composite body/sheds dielectric strength/creepage આપે.
  2. Designed pin/fixing body પકડે;top groove/approved tie conductor પકડે.
  3. Crossarm hardware mechanical force વહન કરે;shaped sheds wet leakage path મર્યાદિત કરે.

Working — ક્રમ તથા કારણ

  1. Live conductorનું load body સહે અને earth supportથી separation રાખે.
  2. Bulk dielectric normal-surge stress અને creepage wet-polluted condition સહે.
  3. V/mechanical ratingsમાં જ વાપરો.Damage-pollutionથી flashover/puncture થઈ શકે.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

Specified dielectric,V/mechanical rating લો.Handling-maintenance authorised personnel જ કરે.

body.en:
Definition

A string of disc units hangs the conductor from the support.

Classification / representative type

  • Pin,suspension,strain,shackle and stay are classified by duty;this card explains Suspension.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Disc units contain dielectric,cap and pin fittings joined by approved couplings.
  2. Porcelain or toughened glass units form a rated series string;composite long-rod alternatives have a fibre core and polymer sheds.
  3. Tower-end hardware and conductor clamp transfer tensile load;grading/corona fittings depend on design.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. The string supports conductor weight and permits limited designed movement.
  2. Voltage divides nonuniformly because shunt capacitance couples fittings to tower/earth.
  3. Suitable string length,grading and maintenance maintain insulation and mechanical reliability.

Limitations and safety

Use the specified dielectric,voltage and mechanical rating;handling/maintenance only by authorised personnel.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Disc string conductorને support પરથી લટકાવે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Duty પ્રમાણે pin,suspension,strain,shackle/stay છે.આ card Suspension સમજાવે છે.

Construction — ભાગ તથા કામ

  1. Discમાં dielectric,cap/pin fittings અને approved couplings હોય.
  2. Porcelain/glass series string હોય.Composite long-rodમાં fibre core/polymer sheds હોય.
  3. Tower hardware/conductor clamp tensile load વહન કરે.Grading-corona fittings design પ્રમાણે હોય.

Working — ક્રમ તથા કારણ

  1. String weight support કરે અને designed movement આપે.
  2. Fittings-tower shunt Cને કારણે V nonuniform વહેંચાય.
  3. યોગ્ય length,grading/maintenanceથી insulation/mechanical reliability જળવાય.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

Specified dielectric,V/mechanical rating લો.Handling-maintenance authorised personnel જ કરે.

body.en:
Definition

A tension arrangement carries conductor pull at dead ends and large direction changes.

Classification / representative type

  • Pin,suspension,strain,shackle and stay are classified by duty;this card explains Strain.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. One or more rated disc/long-rod strings connect tension hardware to a support.
  2. Dead-end clamps,shackles and yoke plates transfer the designed mechanical tension.
  3. Parallel strings or special fittings may be used when the specified mechanical duty requires them.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. The load path is along the string rather than merely vertical weight support.
  2. The conductor remains electrically isolated from support while tensile force is transferred.
  3. Angle,broken-wire and environmental loading must be covered by the authorised design.

Limitations and safety

Use the specified dielectric,voltage and mechanical rating;handling/maintenance only by authorised personnel.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Dead-end/મોટા turn પર strain arrangement conductor pull સહે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Duty પ્રમાણે pin,suspension,strain,shackle/stay છે.આ card Strain સમજાવે છે.

Construction — ભાગ તથા કામ

  1. Rated disc-long-rod strings tension hardwareને support સાથે જોડે.
  2. Dead-end clamp,shackle/yoke plate tension વહન કરે.
  3. Specified mechanical dutyમાં parallel strings/special fittings વપરાય.

Working — ક્રમ તથા કારણ

  1. મુખ્ય load path stringની દિશામાં છે;ફક્ત weight support નથી.
  2. Tensile force transfer સાથે conductor supportથી electrically isolated રહે.
  3. Angle,broken-wire/environmental loading authorised designમાં આવવું જોઈએ.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

Specified dielectric,V/mechanical rating લો.Handling-maintenance authorised personnel જ કરે.

body.en:
Definition

A compact spool-type insulator supports LVconductors at suitable points.

Classification / representative type

  • Pin,suspension,strain,shackle and stay are classified by duty;this card explains Shackle.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. A porcelain spool/body has a conductor groove and mounting hole.
  2. Bolt/strap brackets attach the body in the approved horizontal/vertical orientation.
  3. An approved tie and groove retain the conductor;hardware clearance prevents bridging the insulation.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Conductor load passes through the body into the bracket/support.
  2. The dielectric separates live conductor and support at its rated low-voltage duty.
  3. Cracked glaze,wrong ties or contamination can defeat the insulation path.

Limitations and safety

Use the specified dielectric,voltage and mechanical rating;handling/maintenance only by authorised personnel.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Compact spool insulator યોગ્ય LVpoints પર conductor support કરે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Duty પ્રમાણે pin,suspension,strain,shackle/stay છે.આ card Shackle સમજાવે છે.

Construction — ભાગ તથા કામ

  1. Porcelain spoolમાં conductor groove/mounting hole હોય.
  2. Bolt-strap bracket approved orientationમાં body પકડે.
  3. Tie/groove conductor પકડે;hardware clearance insulation bridging અટકાવે.

Working — ક્રમ તથા કારણ

  1. Conductor load bodyથી bracket/supportમાં જાય.
  2. Dielectric rated LVdutyમાં live conductor/support અલગ રાખે.
  3. Cracks,wrong ties/pollutionથી insulation path બગડે.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

Specified dielectric,V/mechanical rating લો.Handling-maintenance authorised personnel જ કરે.

body.en:
Definition

A strain insulator interrupts the metallic stay-wire path at its designed location.

Classification / representative type

  • Pin,suspension,strain,shackle and stay are classified by duty;this card explains Stay.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. A strong porcelain egg/stay body has separate wire passage grooves.
  2. Stay wires wrap through the approved passages so the body carries the specified load.
  3. Anchors,fittings and placement follow the pole/stay design;the insulator is not a substitute for required earthing.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. The dielectric interrupts a continuous conductive path through the stay.
  2. Mechanical stay tension is transferred through the rated body and fittings.
  3. Ground-level accessibility and placement need approved safety design;never touch an apparently insulated stay.

Limitations and safety

Use the specified dielectric,voltage and mechanical rating;handling/maintenance only by authorised personnel.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Strain insulator designed સ્થાને metallic stay-wire path તોડે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Duty પ્રમાણે pin,suspension,strain,shackle/stay છે.આ card Stay સમજાવે છે.

Construction — ભાગ તથા કામ

  1. Strong porcelain stay bodyમાં અલગ wire passage grooves હોય.
  2. Approved passagesમાં stay wiresથી body specified load વહન કરે.
  3. Anchor,fitting/placement design પ્રમાણે હોય.Insulator જરૂરી earthingનો substitute નથી.

Working — ક્રમ તથા કારણ

  1. Dielectric stayનો continuous conductive path તોડે છે.
  2. Stay tension rated body/fittingsથી transfer થાય.
  3. Accessibility/placement authorised safety designથી નક્કી થાય.Insulated દેખાતો stay પણ નસ્પર્શો.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

Specified dielectric,V/mechanical rating લો.Handling-maintenance authorised personnel જ કરે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Electrical and mechanical performance must both remain adequate in the actual environment.

Explanation and application

  • Porcelain offers ceramic strength/glaze;toughened glass permits visual defect clues;composite insulators use a load-bearing fibre core,polymer sheds and metal end fittings.Neither all glass nor all polymer products are equivalent.
  • Desirable properties:high dielectric/mechanical strength,high insulation resistance,adequate creepage,low porosity and resistance to tracking,weather and thermal stress.
  • Flashover follows the external air/surface path;puncture passes through the dielectric and generally damages it.Contamination,moisture,cracks,overvoltage,corrosion and mechanical overload are distinct failure causes.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Actual environmentમાં electrical/mechanical performance બંને યોગ્ય રહેવા જોઈએ.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Porcelainમાં strength/glaze,glassમાં visual defect clues અને compositeમાં fibre core,polymer sheds/metal ends હોય.બધા products સમાન નથી.
  • High dielectric/mechanical strength,R,creepage,low porosity અને tracking-weather-thermal resistance જોઈએ.
  • Flashover બહારની air-surface path છે;puncture dielectricની અંદરથી થઈ સામાન્ય રીતે damage કરે.Pollution,moisture,cracks,overvoltage,corrosion/overload અલગ causes છે.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Three equal series capacitances C;each relevant intermediate fitting has tower shunt capacitance kC.Ignore leakage and conductor shunts.Number units from tower to line.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Let top-disc voltage V1=v.KCLat the first junction gives V2=(1+k)v.
  2. The next junction shunt current corresponds to k(V1+V2);therefore V3=V2+k(V1+V2)=(1+3k+k²)v.
  3. Total string voltage V=(3+4k+k²)v;for k>0the line-end V3is greatest.
  4. String efficiency ηs=V/(3Vmax)×100=(3+4k+k²)/[3(1+3k+k²)]×100.

Interpretation and check

ηsmeasures voltage utilisation,not power-conversion efficiency.Other shunt models/string lengths need their own node equations.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

ત્રણ equal C,intermediate fittingની tower shunt kC લો.Leakage/conductor shunts ignore કરો.Number towerથી line તરફ લો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Top V1=v લો.First junction KCLથી V2=(1+k)v છે.
  2. Next shunt currentમાં k(V1+V2) આવે;તેથી V3=V2+k(V1+V2)=(1+3k+k²)v છે.
  3. Total V=(3+4k+k²)v છે.k>0માં line-end V3 સૌથી વધુ છે.
  4. ηs=V/(3Vmax)×100=(3+4k+k²)/[3(1+3k+k²)]×100 છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

ηs voltage utilisation છે,power efficiency નથી.અલગ shunt model/lengthમાં પોતાની node equations જોઈએ.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Make disc voltages more nearly equal without compromising field grading or mechanical duty.

Explanation and application

  • Longer suitable crossarms reduce relative tower shunt capacitance k and improve distribution;space and mechanical constraints remain.
  • Capacitance grading selects disc capacitances to suit their required voltage/current distribution;it is not random mixing of replacement units.
  • Grading/guard rings reshape the electric field and can improve string voltage distribution and corona behaviour when correctly designed.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Field grading/mechanical duty બગાડ્યા વિના disc V લગભગ સમાન બનાવો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • યોગ્ય longer crossarmsથી relative tower shunt k ઘટે/V distribution સુધરે;space-mechanical constraints રહે.
  • Capacitance gradingમાં required V-I પ્રમાણે discs લો.Random replacement mix નકરો.
  • Proper grading-guard rings field reshape કરી V distribution/corona સુધારે છે.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Use the stated three-disc model,k=0.2and total voltage across the STRING=38.4kV,not a line-line supply voltage.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Voltage ratios:1,1+k,1+3k+k²=1,1.2,1.64;sum=3.84.
  2. Top voltage v=38.4/3.84=10kV;middle12kV;line-end16.4kV.
  3. ηs=38.4/(3×16.4)×100=78.05%approximately.

Interpretation and check

Check10+12+16.4=38.4kV;for a given balanced ACline-line rating first use Vstring=VLL/√3where the string is phase-to-earth.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Stated modelમાં k=0.2/STRING V=38.4kV લો;આ line-line V નથી.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Ratios1,1+k,1+3k+k²=1,1.2,1.64 અને sum3.84 છે.
  2. Top v=38.4/3.84=10kV,middle12kV/line-end16.4kV છે.
  3. ηs=38.4/(3×16.4)×100≈78.05% છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Check10+12+16.4=38.4kV છે.Balanced phase-earth string માટે VLLમાંથી પહેલાં Vstring=VLL/√3 લો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Uniform load wNper horizontal metre,span L,horizontal tension H;small sag/parabolic model,equal support height.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Choose the lowest point as x=0,y=0.At distance x,the vertical load component is wx.
  2. Tangent slope dy/dx=(vertical tension)/(horizontal tension)=wx/H.
  3. Integrate:y=wx²/(2H),using y=0at x=0.
  4. At each support x=L/2,so sag f=wL²/(8H).End tension Tend=√[H²+(wL/2)²].

Interpretation and check

wuses N/m,not kg/m;convert mass loading with g.His not the end tension.For large sag use a catenary/full approved design.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Uniform wN/horizontal metre,span L/H લો.Small-sag parabolic model/equal heights ધારો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Lowest point x=0/y=0 લો.Distance xએ vertical load wx છે.
  2. Slope dy/dx=wx/H છે.
  3. Integrate કરતાં y=wx²/(2H) છે,x=0એ y=0થી constant zero થાય.
  4. Support x=L/2 હોવાથી f=wL²/(8H) છે.End tension Tend=√[H²+(wL/2)²] છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

w N/m છે,kg/m નહીં.Massને gથી convert કરો.H end tension નથી.Large sagમાં catenary/full design લો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Vertical load w,level horizontal span L,right support habove the left;lowest point lies between supports.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Let lowest-point distances to left/right be x1,x2;then x1+x2=L.
  2. From y=wx²/(2H),h=w(x2²−x1²)/(2H)=wL(x2−x1)/(2H).
  3. Solve:x1=L/2−Hh/(wL),x2=L/2+Hh/(wL).Sags below supports are wx1²/(2H),wx2²/(2H).
  4. For L200m,H20000N,w10N/m,h5m:x1=50m,x2=150m,sags0.625m/5.625m.

Interpretation and check

If x1<0the assumed interior lowest point is invalid.Ground clearance also depends on actual ground profile,not only support height.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Vertical w/span L અને right support left કરતાં h ઊંચું છે.Lowest point બંને વચ્ચે છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Lowest pointથી left/right distances x1/x2 લો.x1+x2=L છે.
  2. y=wx²/(2H)થી h=w(x2²−x1²)/(2H)=wL(x2−x1)/(2H) છે.
  3. Solve કરતાં x1=L/2−Hh/(wL),x2=L/2+Hh/(wL) છે.Supportની નીચે sag wx1²/(2H)/wx2²/(2H) છે.
  4. L200m,H20000N,w10N/m/h5mમાં x1=50m,x2=150m/sags0.625m-5.625m છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

x1<0હોયતો interior-lowest assumption ખોટી છે.Ground clearance actual terrain પરથી પણ નક્કી થાય.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Separate vector loading from the thermal/mechanical state of the conductor.

Explanation and application

  • Ice increases vertical mass and exposed diameter;wind adds transverse force.Resultant load wr=√(wv²+wh²)inclines the sag plane,where wvincludes conductor plus ice weight.
  • At a declared unchanged H,resultant sag fr=wrL²/(8H);vertical component fv=wvL²/(8H),lateral component fh=whL²/(8H).Actual Hchanges with weather/state and requires a design state calculation.
  • Heating usually expands a restrained conductor,reduces tension and increases sag;cooling can increase tension.Creep and elastic strain must be allowed in design.Temperature is not merely another added force.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Vector loading અને conductor thermal-mechanical state અલગ સમજો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Ice vertical weight/exposed diameter વધારે;wind transverse force ઉમેરે.wr=√(wv²+wh²)માં wv conductor+ice છે.Sag plane ઢળે છે.
  • Declared same Hમાં fr=wrL²/(8H),fv=wvL²/(8H)/fh=whL²/(8H) છે.Actual H weather-stateથી બદલાય;design state calculation જોઈએ.
  • Heatingથી expansion/tension ઘટતાં sag સામાન્ય રીતે વધે;cooling tension વધારે શકે.Creep/elastic strainનો allowance લો.Temperature ફક્ત added force નથી.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

L200m,H20000N,self-weight10N/m.Same-Hcomparison only:ice adds5N/m and wind20N/m.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Without ice/wind:f=10×200²/(8×20000)=2.5m.
  2. Under the stated loads wv=15N/m,wh=20N/m,wr=25N/m.
  3. Resultant sag6.25m;vertical sag3.75m;lateral displacement5m at the lowest point under the stated same-Hmodel.

Interpretation and check

Check√(3.75²+5²)=6.25m.These values are computed illustrations,not approved span/clearance ratings.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

L200m,H20000N/self-weight10N/m લો.Same-H comparisonમાં ice5N/m/wind20N/m ઉમેરો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Ice-wind વિના f=10×200²/(8×20000)=2.5m છે.
  2. Stated loadsમાં wv=15N/m,wh=20N/m/wr=25N/m છે.
  3. Same-H modelમાં resultant sag6.25m,vertical3.75m/lateral5m છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Check√(3.75²+5²)=6.25m છે.આ computed example છે;approved span-clearance ratings નથી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Corona is a local discharge caused by sufficient electric stress near a conductor,not a normal metallic short circuit.

Explanation and application

  • Factors include conductor radius,spacing,surface roughness,air density,weather and applied voltage/waveform.Rain/rough fittings can raise corona activity.
  • Losses and demerits:power loss,audible noise,radio interference,chemical action and insulation/fitting stress.Possible limited benefit:surge-energy dissipation/attenuation,but deliberate corona is not an economical protection substitute.
  • Reduce surface stress with suitable diameter/bundles,smooth clean fittings,grading rings and designed spacing;maintain damaged hardware.No universal safe approach distance follows from a corona sketch.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

પૂરતો local electric stress conductorની આસપાસ discharge કરે તે corona છે;સામાન્ય metallic short નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Radius,spacing,roughness,air density,weather/V-waveform અસર કરે.Rain/rough fitting corona વધારી શકે.
  • Demeritsમાં power loss,noise,radio interference,chemical action/insulation stress આવે.Limited benefit surge attenuation હોઈ શકે;તે protectionનો economical substitute નથી.
  • Suitable diameter-bundle,smooth fittings,grading rings/spacingથી stress ઘટાડો.Damaged hardware maintain કરો.Sketch પરથી safe approach distance નધારો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

ROWis the legally/technically controlled corridor needed for routing,clearances,access and safe operation.

Explanation and application

  • Width depends on voltage,tower/conductor arrangement,sag/swing,terrain and applicable rules;it is not one universal fixed width for all transmission lines.
  • Route surveys,landowner identification,environmental/forest permissions,access and public safety are coordinated with authorised agencies.Compensation/right of use is not automatically full land ownership.
  • Use the dated applicable central/state/project rules for widths and compensation;these notes do not invent current legal percentages or permit construction.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

ROW routing,clearance,access/safe operation માટેનો legal-technical controlled corridor છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Width V,tower-conductor arrangement,sag-swing,terrain/rulesથી બદલાય;બધા lines માટે એક fixed width નથી.
  • Route survey,landowner identity,environment-forest permission,access/public safety authorised agencies સાથે નક્કી થાય.Compensation-use right એટલે આપોઆપ ownership નથી.
  • Width-compensation માટે dated central-state-project rules લો.આ notes current legal percentages કે construction permission કલ્પિત નથી કરતી.
